title_or_table: American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B25064, Median Gross Rent (Dollars); Table B19013, Median Household Income in the Past 12 Months; Table B25003, Tenure
geography: 50 states and DC, with a United States row (code US)
universe_or_base: Median gross rent: renter-occupied units paying cash rent. Median household income: all households. Renter households: renter-occupied units
unit: dollars a month (rent), dollars a year (income, in 2025 dollars), households; annual_rent_as_pct_of_median_income is 12 times median rent over median income, computed by the studio
qualification: The two medians describe different households (renters paying cash rent, and all households), so their ratio is a rough gauge of rent against a typical income in the state; a chart of the two carries the Association label

code.description: USPS state code, US for the nation

annual_rent_as_pct_of_median_income.description: 12 times median rent over median household income, computed

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Tables B25064, B19013 and B25003, median gross rent, median household income and renter households, 2025, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Survey estimates; the rent median covers renters paying cash rent and the income median covers all households.
